summary: The P0 design is ready for approval from the product-architecture perspective. The current product authority and target 2.0 authority are separated, fact-first and TerminalAuthority remain shadow-only pending P2 qualification, public runtime reachability and phase gates are documented, and the reviewed changes are governance/evidence changes rather than a product cutover.

non_blocking_findings.title: Fast regression repair summary is not listed in design-manifest document hashes
non_blocking_findings.evidence: acceptance/p0-fast-regression-repair.json is bound by the evidence index but was absent from design-manifest.json document_hashes on the reviewed tree.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add the regression repair summary to document_hashes during the next manifest update.

non_blocking_findings.title: The evidence index needs an immutable approval binding
non_blocking_findings.evidence: acceptance/evidence-index.json is schema-validated but is not itself listed in document_hashes on the reviewed tree.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Bind the final evidence-index hash in an immutable approval object such as the annotated design tag, or document another non-circular binding.

non_blocking_findings.title: Cold-baseline anomalies remain later-phase work
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The P0 summaries retain deferred-budget attribution, legacy reserve attribution, and 103 length-finished responses as explicit limitations.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Carry these observations into P1/P2 replay and proof-kernel qualification; do not use them to weaken promotion.

non_blocking_findings.title: Remote CI and the local Black check are not yet verified
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The evidence index records that the branch was not pushed and that the local Black executable did not complete.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Confirm these hygiene checks when an authorized remote validation path is available.

checks.name: reviewed_commit_and_tree_identity
checks.evidence: The review was bound to commit b74e6b6e82224d487392ad7e03d794d6592a514a and tree aca131c453e2176944527a1bd3902c08d1bc3948.

checks.name: current_and_target_authority_separation
checks.evidence: docs/architecture.md remains the current product authority while the 2.0 package is explicitly a target design with phase-gated cutover.

checks.name: fact_first_shadow_only
checks.evidence: The design and current architecture prohibit shadow facts from rewriting the stable V1 decision slice before P2 qualification.

checks.name: terminal_authority_shadow_only
checks.evidence: The proof-kernel TerminalAuthority decision is recorded for comparison but cannot override stable product dispositions before the P2 gates pass.

checks.name: runtime_reachability_and_phase_gates
checks.evidence: The runtime-reachability manifest, P0 evidence records, and P0-P7 entry/exit/stop conditions provide an auditable cutover sequence.

checks.name: design_consistency
checks.evidence: The ADRs, contracts, deprecation plan, implementation governance, and phase documents consistently preserve stable authority until later qualification gates pass.

limitations: The review was read-only and did not independently rerun the recorded test suite.
Ignored external benchmark aggregates were absent from the worktree and were assessed through their recorded hashes and summaries only.
Remote CI was not run because the branch was not pushed.
This approval covers P0 product architecture; it does not approve P2 proof soundness or a runtime cutover.
